route.objective: Plan the minimum validated release-assurance routing to evaluate artifact traceability, release evidence, operational readiness, and produce a consolidated go/no-go readiness handoff for FieldOps Mobile 4.8 without re-assessing change impact or evaluating ITIL alignment.

not_selected.reason: The current impact register was reviewed on 3 September 2026 and explicitly supplied as complete for this decision point, with explicit user instructions not to redo impact analysis.
ITIL practice alignment was not requested, is not materially required for this release decision, and was explicitly excluded by the user.

stop_rules: Preserve T-04 as NOT RUN and maintain rollback execution timing and fleet recovery as unevidenced/Unknown; do not treat a draft procedure as a validated rollback.
Preserve high-severity defect DEF-17 as OPEN; do not interpret the Product Owner's statement as defect closure, technical mitigation, or authorized risk acceptance.
Preserve the proposed sync failure alert threshold (>20 failures/5 min) and deployment window (Saturday 22:00–23:30) as Candidate states, not approved production configurations.
Preserve change record CHG-9481 as Draft; do not invent Change Authority approval or bypass the local policy requiring an approved record prior to implementation.
Preserve pilot testing (40 devices / 2 depots) as test-environment verification without overgeneralizing it to full-fleet production deployment verification.
Ensure prepare-solution-change-readiness reflects accurate conditional or not-ready statuses based on missing/failed upstream evidence without manufacturing a green go-decision.
route.expected_final_artifact: A consolidated solution and change-readiness handoff report synthesizing traceability coverage, verified release and test evidence, operational gaps (untested rollback, draft runbook, candidate thresholds), and unresolved blockers (open DEF-17, draft CHG-9481) to support a defensible go/no-go release decision.
